newsitem.title: UK: Namibian $30 mln international loan is a first.
newsitem.headline: Namibian $30 mln international loan is a first.

text.p: LONDON, June 19 (LPC) - Arranger Fuji and co-arrangers BNP and ING-Barings have launched syndication of a $30 million syndicated loan for First National Bank of Namibia.

The one-year term loan is a milestone for the country. The transaction is the first international deal for a Namibian issuer, and marks the beginning of the country's campaign to create an international capital market profile.

The one-year term loan is priced at 50 bps over LIBOR, with an all-in spread of 60 bps, and has bullet repayment. First National Bank of Namibia is the country's largest commercial bank, and is a subsidiary of First National Bank of Southern Africa, which holds a 78% stake.

The Namibian government and economy have been stable since the country's independence in 1990 - Namibia boasts Africa's second largest stock exchange after South Africa, and the Namibian dollar is on a 1:1 par with the South African Rand.
Henry Ansbacher acted as adviser to the borrower.
